Name: Elevator
Author: Ilyaki
Description:
Adds a hotel building to hold unlimited farmhand cabins.

This mod should be installed on both the server and all the clients. The clients aren't forced to install the mod, but if their cabin is inside the elevator building they will never be able to get in or out.

Type help in the SMAPI console to see all the server commands you need for setting up an elevator building.
If you can't get the mod working, try running elevator_addcabin once to set it in motion.

[b][size=4]Setup[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]elevator_makebuildinghere: Creates the elevator building where you stand. You must run this first.
[*]elevator_addcabin: Creates a cabin inside the elevator building. You must run this at least once.
[*]elevator_goto PLAYERNAME: Teleports you to a cabin inside the elevator building.
[*]elevator_relocatecabin PLAYERNAME: Moves a player's cabin to the elevator building.
[*]elevator_bringbackcabin PLAYERNAME: Moves a player's cabin outside of the elevator building.
[*]elevator_removeunusedelevatorcabins: Removes unoccupied cabins inside the elevator building. (Use this to prevent anyone creating a character inside the building).
[*]To remove the elevator building, use Robin's carpenter menu.
[/list]

[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
[list=1][*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[b][size=4]Hotel texture customisation[/size][/b]
You can edit the Hotel.png in the mod folder to change the hotel texture.
The #required-mods channel on funny-snek's discord server contains some modded Hotel.pngs
